LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_CinderSword.label: Cinder Ash
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_CinderSword.description: Mingyuan's longsword. It is designed as a high-accuracy, high-penetration melee weapon and the main source of Life Burn layers.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RainbowBow.label: Long Rainbow
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RainbowBow.description: Mingyuan's longbow. It is designed for full-map four-shot attacks; ranged hits apply Life Burn through Mingyuan's global hit logic.
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_Mingyuan_RainbowArrow.label: Long Rainbow Arrow
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InfernoArmor.label: Molten Inferno Armor
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InfernoArmor.description: Mingyuan's full-coverage inferno armor. Design target: extreme armor, heat adaptation, reduced incoming damage, improved movement, dodge, healing, carrying capacity, and damage.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningFeatherCrown.label: Turbid Burning Feather Crown
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningFeatherCrown.descript: Mingyuan's feather crown, occupying the head slot and covering the full head. Design target: extreme armor, dodge, incoming damage reduction, faster aiming, and lower ranged cooldown.
